title.narrative: Rule of Law and Democracy Monitoring in Tanzania

description.narrative:
The project is anchored towards rule of law and democracy monitoring in Tanzania. This assignment seeks to strengthen the basis for engagement on democracy and rule of law in Tanzania based on credible and empirical evidence on key trends related to the rule of law and civic space in the country.
The evidence is generated to promote public discourse and debate on social justice and the rule of law in Tanzania.
